newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Fake Kuwait notes in circulation, number limited.
newsitem.headline: Fake Kuwait notes in circulation, number limited.

text.p: Kuwait's Central Bank on Wednesday said fake banknotes were observed in circulation, but the volume of these notes was "immaterial".

"The Central Bank has been advised that a limited number of 10 and 20 Kuwaiti dinar counterfeit banknotes are being circulated," deputy governor Ali al-Mousa commenting on a report by the English-language Arab Times newspaper.
"Our assessment is that such circulation is immaterial. All counterfeit banknotes seized are still in single digits in either denomination," Mousa added.
The Arab Times said forged 10-dinar notes were in circulation.
Security authorities were notified, he said.
"The Central Bank and all banks in Kuwait are fully equipped to deal with any such attempt to circulate counterfeit banknotes," said Mousa.
